subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should this issue stay open as the Firefox HTTPS reverse-proxy WebSocket investigation while the shared CSP/Zod fix remains tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362?
rationale: The CSP evidence overlaps an open security-sensitive thread, but the reported WebSocket 1006 and secure-context/device-identity observations need live reverse-proxy proof before maintainers can safely choose a gateway or CSP change.

options.title: Keep separate pending live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox reverse-proxy validation and resolve the shared Zod/CSP defect through the existing CSP thread.

options.title: Fold into the CSP thread
options.body: Treat the WebSocket 1006 as startup fallout from blocked JavaScript and consolidate all remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

options.title: Accept broader CSP relaxation
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept unsafe-eval as the compatibility tradeoff, but that should be a deliberate security decision with browser proof.

recommendation.title: Keep separate pending live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox reverse-proxy validation and resolve the shared Zod/CSP defect through the existing CSP thread.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history across Control UI CSP, gateway serving, and reverse-proxy/security behavior.
